output.question: What should I change on HX-5000 if a stack is oscillating or briefly separating between members?
output.reference_answer: For Helix HX-5000 on 7.3, use matched-length stack cables between all members to reduce master election oscillation, keep control-plane load below 60 percent until the software is upgraded, and pin the desired master by setting a higher priority on the preferred member. Avoid adding or removing members during the unstable period. On 7.6, keep stack cabling under 1 m when possible and avoid chaining all members through a single long physical path.
